chunk.note: one demo3 `characterization` chunk, from demo3's own patch plan at demo3's own seed. Every mode propagates on this grid, which is why the boolean mask is a full-array gather.

closure_against_committed_record.committed_issue: CHE-118 (M5.1), the run this issue is measured against
closure_against_committed_record.note: the replica's instrumented total against the committed stage divided by its chunk count. Agreement is what licenses reading the fractions above as fractions of the 86.9 s rather than of a probe's own workload. The replica is instrumented, so it is expected to read slightly under the shipped call -- the difference is the emitter's own function-call and argument handling, which no region covers.

consequence: The stage is not FFT-flop-bound in the way that would justify a device port, and it is not dominated by per-patch Python overhead either. It is embarrassingly parallel work being done on one core, plus measurable waste. Threading and hoisting take it 2.64x faster with every emitted ray bitwise unchanged, so no capability declaration widens, no estimator changes, and no committed number needs re-measuring.

density.what: abs, sum and divide over the mode vector

draw.what: `Generator.choice(p=density)` over the patch's 90601 modes. Internally a cumulative sum over all of them plus a search for `secondary_count` uniforms, so it is O(modes) per patch and not O(picks)

extract_patch_and_pad.what: the DOE window and its zero-padded frame

mask_gather_directions.what: PURE WASTE: `dir_x[propagating]` and `dir_y[propagating]` are functions of the padded grid and the wavelength alone, and were recomputed for every patch

mask_gather_spectrum.what: a boolean-mask gather over a mask that is entirely true on this grid, so it returns exactly `np.ravel` for 780x the cost

patch_fft.what: the padded per-patch transform, 301^2 complex128. Independent per patch and numpy releases the GIL in it, which is why threading is available at all

ray_assembly.what: amplitude, direction cosines and launch positions per patch

spectral_grid_setup.what: once per call, not per patch

finding: Of 282 ms a chunk, 57% is the padded FFT and 22% is the spectral draw. Both are independent per patch and both release the GIL, so both thread. A further 7.0% was not work at all: two loop-invariant gathers recomputed per patch, and a boolean mask that is entirely true.

memory_report.signal_rationale: container cgroup swap, not host swap: host swap is non-zero at rest on this machine (CHE-64), so a host-swap delta is not attributable to this run

notes: One emission at the shipped thread count. The arm medians in the payload are the figures to quote; this block is what carries the environment fingerprint and the memory guards.

speedup.note: two denominators because they answer different questions. Against the single-threaded SHIPPED code the ratio isolates what the threads bought; against the as-committed replica it is what demo3 actually gains, and it includes the hoist and the ravel as well.
